name: mirage
text: You're right, sorry: the '6+0' on that card is a count of requests, not keys. You have 3 keys and all 3 are refused (403), so the card must not say working. It was green because the same card also counts PinnWire's answers. I'm changing it so that when every key is refused it turns amber/red and says 'every key refused'. Those 3 pinnapi keys need replacing or removing in Settings > APIs; PinnWire is the one answering Pinnacle now.
